reviews.name: Kickresume
reviews.note: HQ Bratislava and language list found on About page. No founding year. Pricing pages (/en/pricing/) show plans for job seekers only (yearly $96, quarterly $54, free unless paid customization options), no employer pricing, so business_model left not-found. Affiliates footer link exists but its target is an external form on form.typeform.com titled Kickresume Partner Program Sign Up, not on the entry domain, so partner_program not-found. Language URLs were not captured; the list comes from the About page text.

reviews.name: TopResume
reviews.note: Partnerships page describes an incentive program for job seekers referral and commission; join form only, no joining steps. About page says part of the Career.io family but no HQ or founding year. Plans page shows job-seeker pricing only (billed monthly, cancel anytime), no employer pricing.

reviews.name: Jobsite
reviews.note: WebFetch returned HTTP 503 for the homepage and /about-us. /recruiters returned HTTP 200 with an empty body in WebFetch; browse.js returned status 200 with an empty text and no links, not blocked. No facts could be quoted.

reviews.name: Lightcast
reviews.note: Menu page says to reach out to the team for integration, which was taken as on-request. The page does not literally say key or feed, so this is a judgement from the quote. Docs at docs.lightcast.dev/apis/ state no access rules, and that domain is not the entry domain, so it is not cited. About, press room and homepage state no HQ, founding year or owner (only over 25 years of experience and offices in several countries).

reviews.name: Jobware
reviews.note: Impressum names the registry court AG Paderborn and the Paderborn address, so hq_country DE is taken from the registry court. Ueber uns gives 1 May 1996 for the first German online job market, founded in Paderborn; the page does not name a parent for the operating company, and the parent (Medien Union, Ludwigshafen) was not requested.

reviews.name: JazzHR
reviews.note: Pricing page gives yearly billing with a discount, a Hero plan at $1,000/yr billed annually, and usage-billed add-ons.

reviews.name: VelvetJobs
reviews.note: About page says Based in Los Angeles, but names no country, so hq_country was not recorded from the city alone. No founding year on About or homepage. Footer copyright is VelvetJobs 2026 only.

reviews.name: LHH
reviews.note: Our presence, newsroom and About pages give no global HQ, HQ country or founding year. About says over 50 years of expertise, which is not a year. Newsroom page content was truncated in the fetch.

blocked.name: Jobsite
blocked.reason: HTTP 503 on homepage and /about-us; /recruiters returned an empty body in both WebFetch and browse.js. Not a challenge page; treated as unreachable.
